description: Check if a screenshot is already cached without capturing a new one. Does not count against your quota. Pass the same parameters you would use for take_screenshot so the cache key matches correctly.

lazy_load.description: For full-page captures: scroll through the page first so lazy-loaded images below the first screen appear (default: false). Slower, usually 1-5 seconds more. Ignored unless full_page is true. Some sites can still differ.

name: check_screenshot_cache
